## TLDR

Finlens is an AI accounting co-pilot built on top of QuickBooks. Automates categorization, provides real-time MRR/ARR/burn dashboards, and generates tax-ready reports. No migration needed. Best for: startup founders using QuickBooks. Price: free (from $49/mo). Rating: 7.7/10

## What is Finlens?

We found Finlens on Product Hunt where it earned 735 upvotes as “AI accounting for founders and accountants.” The key insight: most startup founders already use QuickBooks but hate the experience. Finlens does not try to replace it. It sits on top of QuickBooks and makes it actually useful.

Founded in 2024 by Md Halim and Pawan Rochwani in San Francisco, Finlens went through Y Combinator and received investment from Accel. They have analyzed over 30 million transactions across their user base. The team is small (about 6 people) but the backing is strong.

# Why Sellers Are Switching from A2X to Link My Books

Discover why ecommerce sellers are switching from A2X to Link My Books for simpler reconciliation, better VAT visibility, faster setup, and lower costs.

Dan Little Co-Founder and CEO

Table of contents

Many multichannel ecommerce sellers switching from A2X to Link My Books are not simply looking for more accounting data; they are actively seeking better operational visibility and a more intuitive user experience.

As marketplaces become increasingly complex, sellers need finance systems that make settlements easier to understand, UK and EU VAT easier to review, and bank reconciliation easier to manage. For growing ecommerce businesses, the core challenge is rarely collecting financial information. The true challenge is transforming that raw, chaotic data into clean, summarized bookkeeping records in Xero or QuickBooks Online (QBO) that are easy to trust and simple to review.

That fundamental shift in priorities—choosing workflow clarity and rapid onboarding over rigid, legacy accounting structures—is the primary reason more sellers and proactive accountants are evaluating Link My Books as their preferred alternative to A2X.

## Key Takeaways from this Post

Sellers are prioritising workflow clarity over accounting complexity. Many businesses are moving to tools that make settlements, VAT, and reconciliation easier to understand and manage.
